ev.q: This report summarizes investigations of six unlinked clusters of skin and soft tissue infections
A total of 34 primary cases and 10 secondary cases were identified in the three states.
The majority were male (73%) and white (63%); 35% were black.
Four patients had bacteremia and required hospitalization for intravenous vancomycin.
Among all 34 primary cases, the time from tattoo to symptom onset was 4--22 days
